title: ANALYTICS ON THE CLOUD
description: Class will learn how to work with infrastructure of cloud platforms, and discussion about distributed computing, focus of course is on programming. Topics covered include MapReduce, parallelism, rewriting of algorithms (statistical, OR, and machine learning) for the cloud, and basics of porting applications so that they run on the cloud
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: IEOR E4501 and IEOR E4523 IEOR E4501 AND IEOR E4523 To introduce students to programming issues around working with clouds for data analytics.
